def reference(vectors):
    q = 0
    ena = 0
    reset_carry = 0
    out = []

    for row in vectors:
        # Determine reset value at the sampled posedge.
        if 'reset' in row:
            rv = row['reset']
            if isinstance(rv, list):
                if len(rv) > 0:
                    reset_edge = rv[0]
                    reset_next = rv[-1]
                else:
                    reset_edge = reset_carry
                    reset_next = reset_carry
            else:
                reset_edge = rv
                reset_next = rv
        else:
            reset_edge = reset_carry
            reset_next = reset_carry

        # sync_reset: reset high at posedge clears q and ena
        if reset_edge:
            q = 0
            ena = 0
        else:
            # bcd_increment: BCD increment modulo 10000
            ones = q & 0xF
            tens = (q >> 4) & 0xF
            hundreds = (q >> 8) & 0xF
            thousands = (q >> 12) & 0xF

            if ones == 9:
                ones = 0
                carry = 1
            else:
                ones += 1
                carry = 0

            if carry:
                if tens == 9:
                    tens = 0
                    carry = 1
                else:
                    tens += 1
                    carry = 0

            if carry:
                if hundreds == 9:
                    hundreds = 0
                    carry = 1
                else:
                    hundreds += 1
                    carry = 0

            if carry:
                if thousands == 9:
                    thousands = 0
                else:
                    thousands += 1

            q_next = (thousands << 12) | (hundreds << 8) | (tens << 4) | ones

            # upper_digit_enables: registered on posedge from previous q
            old_ones = q & 0xF
            old_tens = (q >> 4) & 0xF
            old_hundreds = (q >> 8) & 0xF

            bit0 = 1 if old_ones == 9 else 0
            bit1 = 1 if (old_ones == 9 and old_tens == 9) else 0
            bit2 = 1 if (old_ones == 9 and old_tens == 9 and old_hundreds == 9) else 0
            ena_next = bit0 | (bit1 << 1) | (bit2 << 2)

            q = q_next
            ena = ena_next

        out.append({"q": q & 0xFFFF, "ena": ena & 0x7})

        # Carry any mid-cycle changes to the start of the next row.
        reset_carry = reset_next

    return out

def reference(vectors):
    # sync_reset: synchronous active-high reset clears q and ena after the sampled posedge.
    # bcd_increment: non-reset posedge increments the 4-digit BCD counter modulo 10000.
    # upper_digit_enables: ena is registered on posedge from the previous q value.
    q = 0
    ena = 0
    result = []
    for row in vectors:
        reset = row['reset']
        if reset == 1:
            # sync_reset: reset has priority over increment and clears outputs.
            q = 0
            ena = 0
        else:
            # upper_digit_enables: compute registered enable from q before this edge.
            ones = q & 15
            tens = (q >> 4) & 15
            hundreds = (q >> 8) & 15
            en = 0
            if ones == 9:
                en = en + 1
                if tens == 9:
                    en = en + 2
                    if hundreds == 9:
                        en = en + 4

            # bcd_increment: increment 4-digit BCD value by one modulo 10000.
            d0 = q & 15
            d1 = (q >> 4) & 15
            d2 = (q >> 8) & 15
            d3 = (q >> 12) & 15

            if d0 < 9:
                d0 = d0 + 1
            else:
                d0 = 0
                if d1 < 9:
                    d1 = d1 + 1
                else:
                    d1 = 0
                    if d2 < 9:
                        d2 = d2 + 1
                    else:
                        d2 = 0
                        if d3 < 9:
                            d3 = d3 + 1
                        else:
                            d3 = 0

            q = (d3 << 12) | (d2 << 8) | (d1 << 4) | d0
            ena = en

        result = result + [{'q': q, 'ena': ena}]
    return result
